_about: Activity types the classifier chooses from. Generated by _build_taxonomy.py - edit that file, not this one. category_id / subcategory_id stay null until Emergent's JSON export is mapped in.

category_labels.cat_12: C12 - End-of-life treatment of sold products

domains.fuel_combustion: Fuels burned in our own or controlled equipment or vehicles: diesel/HSD, petrol, LPG, PNG/CNG, coal, furnace oil, biomass, kerosene; also lines that are explicitly the upstream / well-to-tank emissions of a fuel
domains.refrigerant_fugitive: Refills or top-ups of refrigerant gas (R-22, R-32, R-410A...), CO2 fire extinguishers, SF6 switchgear gas
domains.industrial_gas: Industrial and welding gases bought in cylinders or bulk: argon, nitrogen, oxygen, acetylene, CO2 shielding gas, gas blends
domains.electricity: Purchased electricity: grid utility bills (MSEDCL, DVVNL...), open access, green tariff, renewable PPA; also lines that are explicitly grid T&D losses
domains.heat_steam_cooling: Purchased steam, hot water, district heating or chilled water
domains.water: Water supply or withdrawal: municipal water bills, tanker water, borewell, recycled water
domains.wastewater: Effluent or sewage discharge and treatment (CETP, ETP, STP charges)
domains.waste: Waste disposal, treatment or recycling: hazardous waste, scrap, e-waste, used oil, sludge, MSW; also waste hauling
domains.freight: Transport of goods by a third party: trucking, lorry receipts, courier, rail, sea or air freight, freight forwarding
domains.business_travel: Employee business travel: flights, trains, taxis, buses, hotel stays, travel agency bookings
domains.employee_commute: Getting employees to and from work: contracted staff buses, cabs, shuttle services, work from home
domains.purchased_goods: Raw materials, components, consumables, packaging and supplies bought for operations
domains.purchased_services: Services bought: maintenance, repair, calibration, testing, training, consulting, IT, security, housekeeping (not refills of refrigerant gas or CO2 fire extinguishers - those are fugitive emissions)
domains.capital_goods: Long-lived assets bought: machinery, plant equipment, vehicles, IT hardware, buildings, electrical equipment
domains.leased_assets: Rent or lease of offices, warehouses, equipment or vehicles without operator - paid by us (upstream) or, when we are the landlord, leased out to others (downstream)
domains.downstream_value_chain: What happens to products after we sell them: customers' processing, use of sold products, end-of-life / take-back / post-consumer recycling of sold products, franchises, investments
domains.non_activity: Not an emissions activity: taxes, statutory fees, permits, consent fees, fines, deposits, advances
